title: GTA 6 Is Officially Finished: Take-Two Confirms Development Is Complete 🎮 #Shorts
description:
Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said on the Nov 9, 2026 earnings call that Rockstar has completed development of GTA 6; the company also raised its forecast on strong preorders. Launch: Nov 19, 2026 (PS5, Xbox Series X|S).
Sources: Take-Two earnings call coverage (GamesBeat, Beebom, Push Square). Footage: official Rockstar Games trailers.
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
